description: This file contains test cases for the security and authentication endpoints of a FastAPI-based application, utilizing pytest and fastapi's TestClient to simulate API calls and validate behaviors such as tenant validation, authorization handling, and error responses.

methods.name: TestClient bare_client()
methods.description: Fixture that provides a TestClient instance for testing the API.

methods.name: test_missing_tenant_header_on_connectors_search_returns_400(bare_client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests that a missing tenant header results in a 400 or 403 response when searching connectors.

methods.name: test_tenant_mismatch_forbidden(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests that providing a mismatched tenant id results in a 403 Forbidden response.

methods.name: test_authorization_header_malformed_token_is_ignored(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Ensures that a malformed Authorization token does not crash the application and allows the request to proceed.

methods.name: test_invalid_tool_name_returns_400(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Checks that requesting an unsupported tool returns a 400 error with appropriate message.

methods.name: test_connectors_metadata_unknown_provider_returns_404(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Verifies that requesting metadata for an unknown provider returns a 404 error.
